What
Two pieces of work on one branch, on top of origin/master (68377e3, after #13):

9 level functions ported from rac2-decomp. Each one's retail code has the same instructions as matched C in rac2-decomp (rac2's cross_identity(): only linker-filled fields masked). The C was copied with every relocated name renamed to this game's from retail's bytes. Where only immediates differed, the literal was changed and the note says "constants adapted". commits.headline: docs: allow inline asm for VU0 code and volatile on hardware memory
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: The rules now allow asm for the VU0 macro-mode/COP2 instructions the compiler cannot emit (lqc2, sqc2, vadd, vsub, vmul, vmadd, vopmula/vopmsub, vdiv, vsqrt, qmfc2/qmtc2, ctc2/cfc2, vcallms), written as the original source plausibly had it: one block per VU0 sequence with real operands and clobbers, or shared helpers in a header. Asm for ordinary EE instructions, or asm that steers register allocation, scheduling or delay slots, stays forbidden. volatile is allowed only on named declarations of…
